Tech industry group urges Trump administration to drop $103,265 H-1B fee proposal, asks how Silicon Valley will hire top talents
Straitcraft: How geography gives Iran leverage and could do the same for India
stories.summary: Since the onset of the US-Iran war over 200 days ago, Iran has been strategically utilizing maritime chokepoints such as Hormuz. This has resulted in a marked decline in oil flows, affecting the global economy and forcing the US to reconsider its stance. Concurrently, India is exploring ways to capitalize on its geographical advantages against China.

stories.title: 'Jhoot ki goonj by frustrated leader': BJP mocks Rahul Gandhi's presser on EC-SIR row
Evening news wrap: Rahul targets Centre, CEC amid SIR row; Iran threatens to extend war to Indian Ocean in case of new US strikes & more
An English artist paid £2,090 for a painting listed only as ‘in the style of’ Helen McNicoll
stories.summary: David Taylor made an astonishing find at a UK auction when he acquired an oil painting incorrectly attributed to Helen McNicoll for just £2,090. After expert examination, it was confirmed to be McNicoll's masterpiece, The Bean Harvest, appraised at £300,000. Canadian collector Pierre Lassonde later purchased the artwork for £174,000, ensuring its return to public viewing after a century, highlighting the often-hidden treasures lurking in regional auction houses.

stories.title: White House bars Politico reporter again despite judge's access order
Meet Lucas Rojas, 16, who turned one inclusive kickball game into a six-team league with 40+ players
stories.summary: Lucas Rojas launched LINKball, a vibrant kickball league designed to unite students with special needs and enthusiastic volunteers. Starting from a charity match, this initiative blossomed into a well-organized league of six teams. Acknowledging his impactful work, Rojas was awarded the $10,000 Gloria Barron Prize. Each season sees over 40 players and 60 volunteers engaging in the program, promoting inclusivity and teamwork through the joy of sports.

stories.title: Seattle’s 'Inconvenience Store': Former 7-Eleven sells tangled USBs, fake corn dogs and more
'Vote chori, kanoon chori, sanstha chori': Rahul Gandhi tears into PM Modi, Amit Shah, CEC Gyanesh Kumar amid SIR row
'No anti-incumbency for BJP': Rahul Gandhi namedrops Saddam, Kim Jong Un to attack Modi govt, EC
Delhi HC denies anticipatory bail to YouTuber Ajeet Bharti in casteist remarks case
stories.summary: Delhi High Court rejected Ajeet Bharti's request for anticipatory bail in a caste-related case. The court determined that a prima facie case was established under the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes Act. Bharti's remarks were deemed derogatory and part of a public social media discussion. His lawyer argued against the applicability of the SC/ST Act based on provocation.

stories.title: 'Needs a miracle': Son of Israeli ambassador to US injured in West Bank ramming attack
The Backstory: When EC disagreements went public, from Seshan to Lavasa
stories.summary: The Election Commission is facing fresh scrutiny after an Indian Express report highlighted disagreements among its members over the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) exercise. The dispute recalls two earlier episodes of internal dissent: TN Seshan’s legal battle over the multi-member poll panel in the 1990s and Ashok Lavasa’s dissent during the 2019 Lok Sabha elections. Both cases shaped debates over the EC’s functioning and authority.

stories.title: 1 killed, 4 injured in knife attack at Benedictine abbey in Poland
Michael Tilson Thomas’ 32-year home is now on sale for $9.85M
stories.summary: Michael Tilson Thomas’s residence in Pacific Heights is now on the market following his passing earlier this year. The mansion was a sanctuary for the musician and his husband Joshua Robison for nearly three decades. Built in 1906, the four-level home features a blend of architectural styles and modern amenities added over the years. Its spacious rooms hosted numerous distinguished guests from the music and architecture worlds.

stories.title: 800,000 bees stolen in Australia; thieves left honey and took colonies
'Manipulated the voter rolls': Mahua Moitra files police complaint against Gyanesh Kumar over SIR row
stories.summary: TMC MP Mahua Moitra has filed a police complaint against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, alleging manipulation of voter rolls. Moitra raised specific concerns over unauthorized amendments to Form 6 related to voter registration. Her allegations came a day after a report stated that Election Commissioners Sukhbir Singh Sandhu and Vivek Joshi had raised objections at least 14 times over 10 months to decisions and orders related to the SIR.

Post-retirement benefits for judges: SC asks Centre to consider a former HC chief justice to head panel
FSSAI proposes to ban 'paneer' label for substitute products, ensure strict disclosure
New California amoeba sets heat record for complex life at 145°F
Florida businessman’s 4 beach lots to become public after a decade and multiple lawsuits
stories.summary: Michael Holderness bought four beachfront lots on Florida’s Siesta Key in 2016 and 2017, leading to years of disputes with Sarasota County over public access and development. Under a settlement, the county will receive the four lots and make them public beach property, while Holderness gets a nearby parcel valued at nearly $2.8 million, $500,000 and permission to build a 5,000-square-foot home.

When the umpires disagree: 10 questions at the heart of the Election Commission row
stories.summary: The Election Commission is facing questions over reported disagreements between two election commissioners and the CEC on electoral-roll management, decision-making and access to voter data. The controversy has also revived broader concerns over how dissent is handled within the poll panel, the role of the CEC, the appointment of election commissioners and safeguards for voters during large-scale roll revisions.

stories.title: Ontario mother of 10 says she received C$6,300 from C$19,000 GoFundMe; sister charged with fraud
stories.summary: Maryanne Mullett, an Ontario mother of ten, sustained injuries while assisting stranded drivers in January 2026. A dedicated GoFundMe campaign raised about C$19,000 to assist her recovery and family needs. Unfortunately, she received merely C$6,300, leading to financial disputes. A family member faces fraud charges related to the funds, and Mullett has since launched a new fundraiser, highlighting the critical need for better protections in crowdfunding efforts.

stories.title: Florida gas prices surge as some stations charge over $5
stories.summary: Drivers in Florida are experiencing rising petrol prices, with some stations exceeding $5 a gallon. The statewide average has reached $4.29 per gallon, the highest since May. This increase is significantly influenced by rising global oil prices caused by geopolitical tensions. As crude oil prices rise, consumers in Florida and beyond are facing higher costs at the pump.

stories.title: 'Should act fairly': Calcutta HC slams EC for assigning 'envelope' symbol to rival TMC faction
stories.summary: In a recent ruling, the Calcutta high court expressed discontent towards the Election Commission concerning its symbol allocation to the Democratic Trinamool Congress. The court challenged the integrity of the symbol distribution process, pointing out the existence of numerous alternatives. Justice Krishna Rao remarked on the legal issues created by these decisions, leading to appeals from parties involved.

stories.title: BJP announces 24 state-level appointments ahead of crucial assembly polls
'Resign within 48 hours': CJP sets deadline for CEC Gyanesh Kumar, warns of nationwide protest
Miami Dolphins star Zach Sieler turned 250-acre Missouri property into outdoor classroom for kids
stories.summary: The Sieler Safe Haven Foundation, founded by Miami Dolphins star Zach Sieler and his wife Hannah in 2022, is developing their 250-acre Missouri property for agriculture, wildlife and outdoor education. The couple plans to raise cattle there while giving children hands-on experiences in farming, conservation, fishing, hunting and land management.

stories.title: Mexican immigrant couple closes Colorado restaurant after 31 years as children build their own lives
stories.summary: A Colorado couple who moved from Mexico in 1995 with their three children opened Los Tarascos and ran it for 31 years. Jose and Maria Caballero are now closing the Fort Collins restaurant, saying they have achieved the dream that brought them to the US: giving their children the chance to build independent lives and careers outside the family business.

stories.title: What is happening between Twitch streamers KitsuFox and Nosiiree? Breakup drama explained
stories.summary: During her live streaming session, KitsuFox revealed that her ex-partner, Nosiiree, had reached out to her even after she tried to block him. She mentioned that he unexpectedly appeared at her residence, causing her significant distress. In response, Nosiiree denied allegations of stalking during his own livestream, professing his love for KitsuFox and voicing concerns about their personal disputes becoming public knowledge.

stories.title: BJP’s Bengal poll spend alone tops Congress’ Rs 249 crore outlay across 5 states, finds ECI
California disabled shoppers allege mall stores pushed them into spending thousands; one spent $50,000+
stories.summary: Serious allegations have arisen against Bee & Co., claiming that the company coerced vulnerable customers, including seniors and individuals with disabilities, into making costly purchases. Rep. Brad Sherman is set to bring these alarming issues to the attention of California Attorney General Rob Bonta. Disturbingly, customers reported spending significant sums while feeling pressured to transact.

stories.title: Kristin Cavallari's 130-acre Tennessee estate gets a two-year home makeover
Rikishi had spent everything on his new home when Yokozuna gave him a blank cheque
'If pardoned for one murder, I'd shoot Gyanesh': VIP chief targets CEC over SIR row
stories.summary: Mukesh Sahani expressed strong dissatisfaction with Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar's conduct regarding the Election Commission's decisions. He accused the commission of operating under BJP influence and indicated potential consequences for its members. Sahani stated that those involved could face imprisonment after the elections in 2029, particularly highlighting Gyanesh Kumar. The Election Commission defended its processes, asserting that internal disagreements were normal and legal compliance was maintained.

stories.title: HOSPEX enters its sixth edition as Kerala’s healthcare ecosystem evolves
stories.summary: How a doctor-led initiative born from the lessons of COVID evolved into a platform for healthcare innovation, entrepreneurship and collaboration

stories.title: How China helped arm Iran before Trump rolled out the red carpet for Xi
stories.summary: China's role as a self-proclaimed peace mediator is put into question with its increasing military backing for Iran. Recent findings indicate a sharp rise in military component deliveries from China, along with a surge in cargo flights by Chinese airlines dedicated to supporting Iranian defense. This partnership adds layers of complexity to U.S.-China diplomatic exchanges in the context of escalating tensions.

stories.title: Engineers used 500,000 cubic yards of Mississippi River sand to build 7 islands and restore 270 acres
stories.summary: Engineers have successfully finalized a habitat restoration initiative at McGregor Lake, utilizing sand from the Mississippi River. This ambitious project involved the construction of seven islands, the enhancement of floodplain forests, and the protection of vital wetlands. The undertaking, spanning six years, has revitalized over 270 acres of aquatic habitats, significantly benefiting local wildlife and fostering greater biodiversity, all while striving to harmonize navigation and ecological preservation.

stories.title: SC asks EC to set timeline for resolving name, symbol dispute between TMC factions
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has urged the Election Commission to address the ongoing factional conflict within the All India Trinamool Congress. It has set a deadline for resolving the party's name and symbol, requiring a decision by Monday. Meanwhile, the Election Commission has temporarily assigned different names and symbols to opposing factions, both of which are vying for control of the party and its assets.

stories.title: Alabama couple bought 21 acres in Jackson Hole decades ago; family retreat now asks $40 million
Australian homeowner blames six trees for damage to her 130-year-old home; court finds no link
stories.summary: A homeowner in Australia blamed six neighbouring trees for damage to her 130-year-old heritage home and sought $23,650.86 for repairs and tree removal. The NSW Land and Environment Court rejected her claim, finding that evidence did not establish a causal link between the trees and the damage, with moisture conditions and other factors identified as possible causes.

Rahul Gandhi speaks to IIT-B student Sahil Wakode’s parents, assures all help
stories.summary: Rahul Gandhi held a video call with Sahil Wakode's parents to offer support after their son's death. Sahil, a second-year BTech student, was found dead shortly after an exam incident. His parents allege caste-based discrimination and are seeking action against those responsible. Protests are ongoing demanding an independent investigation into his death.

Daniel Levy got £27m after leaving Tottenham in 2025; total club earnings reach £88m
stories.summary: On September 4, 2025, Daniel Levy officially stepped down as the executive chairman of Tottenham Hotspur, receiving a £27 million payout that covered both his salary and bonuses. Over his impressive 25-year tenure, Levy amassed earnings of about £61 million. This brings his total compensation to an astonishing £88 million, which coincidentally matches the amount Tottenham earned from Harry Kane's transfer to Bayern Munich.

Officiating Jathedar of Akal Takht writes to Pakistan Punjab CM for protection of Sikh heritage sites in Lahore
stories.summary: Giani Kuldip Singh Gargajj wrote to Pakistan's Punjab Chief Minister regarding the protection of Sikh historical sites. He specifically mentioned the importance of Lal Khooh and Kattari Chandu in Lahore's Walled City. Gargajj requested an inquiry into the current status of these heritage sites. He suggested involving experts from various departments to assess the historical significance of these locations.

Putin says record turnout shows Russians back his military agenda in Ukraine
stories.summary: Vladimir Putin stated that high voter turnout in the parliamentary election reflects public support for government policies. Preliminary results indicated that United Russia secured a significant majority in the Duma. The election included voting in Ukrainian territories claimed by Russia, which Ukraine considers illegal. Amid ongoing Ukrainian drone attacks, authorities extended voting days and allowed online voting in some regions.

stories.title: California removed 44,000 trout from Sierra lakes, helping frog numbers soar from 190 to 18,800
$100 Pocket Muon Detector: Students build handheld CosmicWatch; sparks citizen-science network
stories.summary: CosmicWatch is a compact and affordable particle detector that can be used for research and education purposes. Developed by physicist Spencer Axani, it costs about $100 and can be assembled easily. The portable device detects muons, allowing students to investigate cosmic-ray interactions and environmental changes. Researchers have successfully utilized it in high-altitude experiments and various scientific studies.

stories.title: Israel kills Hamas finance chief in Gaza strike, Netanyahu says ‘won’t stop’ until group no longer exists
Badrinath Dham sees record 17.79 lakh pilgrims so far this year
stories.summary: Badrinath Dham has experienced a significant increase in pilgrimage, recording over 1.77 million visitors as of September 22. This surpasses the previous annual footfall record set in 2023. Visitor numbers have rebounded following declines due to the 2014 disaster and the Covid-19 pandemic. The government is enhancing facilities and safety measures to accommodate the growing number of devotees.

stories.title: Pakistan appoints former army general Nauman Mahmood as first head of Mecca alliance
Why Iran looms large over Trump-Xi talks in White House
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump is planning to address Chinese President Xi Jinping regarding China's support for Iran. The discussion will follow reports linking Chinese entities to lethal satellite imagery provided to Iran prior to an attack. This attack on US troops in Jordan killed three soldiers and wounded others, marking a significant escalation. The meeting will also cover other critical topics like trade, AI, and Taiwan.

stories.title: Donald Trump says Canada has too many immigrants, but the math doesn’t add up
stories.summary: Canada has recently admitted a record number of permanent residents, primarily focusing on economic immigration programs. In contrast, the US processes significantly more green cards through family-based categories than Canada does. India's immigrants play critical roles in both countries, particularly in skilled job sectors. Trump's comments regarding immigration have drawn criticism for being racially charged and factually inaccurate.

stories.title: 1 Indian killed, 19 rescued after MV Cape Dao attacked off Oman; MEA calls for end to shipping attacks
stories.summary: In a tragic incident off the coast of Oman, the MV Cape Dao was attacked while en route to India, resulting in the death of one Indian seafarer. Nineteen others were successfully rescued, and the Indian Ministry of External Affairs expressed its condolences. The embassy in Oman is actively coordinating the repatriation of the crew, reiterating India's commitment to ensuring safe navigation in international waters.

stories.title: India's proposal under consideration for safe Black Sea shipping, Zelenskyy says
stories.summary: India, Egypt, and Turkey are exploring maritime truce options for safe navigation in the Black Sea. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy indicated readiness to support a truce if Russia responds positively. India's External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar is actively engaging with both Ukraine and Russia to mediate the conflict. Disruptions in shipping have impacted grain supplies globally, raising concerns among multiple countries.

stories.title: She turned America’s waste paper into Chinese packaging: How Zhang Yin built her billion-dollar empire
stories.summary: Zhang Yin launched her paper-trading venture in Hong Kong in 1985 with a simple investment strategy. Spotting a lucrative market in collecting waste paper from the United States to ship to China, she founded America Chung Nam, eventually becoming the top exporter of this recyclable material. Expanding further, she created Nine Dragons Paper, seeing tremendous growth in China’s booming economy.

stories.title: Another Trump-Putin meeting soon? US invites Russian Prez to G20 summit in Dec
stories.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio has confirmed that President Vladimir Putin has been invited to the upcoming G20 summit in December. Rubio emphasized that direct engagement between President Trump and world leaders could address important issues. There have been discussions on limited ceasefires in the ongoing Russia-Ukraine war, with proposals from various countries. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has expressed readiness for negotiations regarding maritime security in the Black Sea.

stories.title: 18-year-old violinist turns concussion recovery into protocol for injured musicians, wins $25,000
Rare Mission Creek Houseboat Sale: Floating home seeks $1.749 million; sales unusually infrequent
stories.summary: Nestled in Mission Creek, San Francisco, a one-of-a-kind floating home is on the market for $1.749 million. This remarkable residence features three bedrooms, three bathrooms, and encompasses 1,980 square feet. Once a modest boat, it has been extensively renovated into this luxurious habitat. With only 20 floating homes in the community, its rarity adds to its allure, especially with proximity to sports venues and tech hubs.

'Judiciary plays second fiddle to govt in judges' appointment’: SC Justice Datta defends collegium system
Pat Boone’s Beverly Hills home, bought for $159,000 in 1960, is now asking nearly $23 million
stories.summary: Pat Boone and his late wife Shirley bought a Beverly Hills estate for $159,000 in 1960. The property is now on the market for $22.95 million after significant appreciation in real estate values. The estate features a six-bedroom residence and a guest house on 1.12 acres. Boone has decided to sell the property after living there for more than six decades.

stories.title: North Carolina town founded in 1907 votes to dissolve itself after years of financial trouble
stories.summary: Ronda, a small town in North Carolina, is facing financial challenges prompting officials to consider dissolution. With severe fiscal issues like late audits and budget violations, the local government is under scrutiny. Despite efforts to resolve these problems, town leaders believe dissolution might be necessary for long-term viability. However, his corporate methods often clashed with local traditions and agricultural practices. The plantation faced numerous obstacles, including pests and diseases harming the rubber trees. Despite investing heavily over seventeen years, Fordlandia ultimately succumbed to failure, illustrating the challenges of integrating foreign business models within local ecosystems.

stories.title: California buried a gas pipeline and removed its final barrier; salmon returned after 70 years
stories.summary: A decades-long barrier blocking fish migration in Alameda Creek was removed in 2025. This action reopened over twenty miles of upstream habitat for migratory fish. Chinook salmon were documented in the newly accessible area shortly after the construction. This marked the first access to this watershed section since the 1950s. The project is part of a larger, nearly thirty-year restoration effort.

In 1998, Alaska miner found a 294.1-ounce gold nugget; 23 years later, it sold for $750,000
stories.summary: In Alaska, a miner's incredible find of a massive gold and quartz specimen led to the unveiling of the largest gold nugget ever discovered in the state. Weighing over twenty pounds, this extraordinary piece, known as the Alaska Centennial Nugget, was held in a private collection until it hit the auction block in 2021, where it fetched an impressive $750,000.

stories.title: California to open 2,060 coastal acres near Diablo Canyon as trails and campsites after $42m deal
stories.summary: A 2,060-acre stretch of California’s Central Coast near the Diablo Canyon nuclear power plant will become a nature preserve after a $42 million conservation deal. The Wildlands Conservancy plans to open Wild Cherry Canyon to the public with hiking trails and campsites while protecting Native American cultural sites. The preserve is expected to open within five years, with guided tours possibly starting next year.

stories.title: Malibu Estate Price Swings: Carson’s former home jumps to $110m; sale history charts luxury surge
stories.summary: Johnny Carson's iconic Malibu estate has embarked on quite a price adventure. Initially acquired for around nine point five million dollars, the property was later listed at eighty-one point five million dollars. It ultimately sold for forty million dollars in 2019 and has now returned to the market, boasting a staggering price tag of one hundred ten million dollars.

stories.title: Georgia city moves pre-Civil War house for hotel; $500,000 restoration turns it into coffee shop
stories.summary: After a careful relocation and restoration, the historic McCray House in Acworth, Georgia, is gearing up to welcome visitors as the new Bizarre Coffee shop. The city has committed nearly half a million dollars to preserve this pre-Civil War building, ensuring it continues to be a vibrant part of the community. As the coffee shop prepares to launch, it promises to inspire fresh memories in the heart of town.

A Swedish company is transforming discarded wind turbines into tiny-solar powered homes and recycled skis
stories.summary: The challenge of decommissioned wind turbine blades is becoming increasingly prominent in Europe. The composite materials used in these blades are notoriously difficult to recycle, leading to significant landfill concerns. In response, various companies are working on inventive reuse projects that could transform these retired assets into valuable materials, underscoring the necessity for a regulatory structure that supports sustainable initiatives in this industry.

stories.title: Mamata Banerjee's Rejinagar pick withdraws from bypolls contest, then retracts
stories.summary: Rabiul Alam Chowdhury's announcement came a day after Sanchita Pradhan Dey, the faction's candidate in Nandigram, withdrew her nomination. She had met West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari with her husband on Thursday, but did not publicly explain her decision to quit. After Dey's withdrawal, Mamata's faction backed Congress candidate Milan Pradhan in Nandigram.

stories.title: ‘Treated on floor, verandah’: Dhaka hospitals struggle as dengue wards overflow
stories.summary: Dengue cases are severely straining Dhaka hospitals, with patients treated on floors and verandas. Over 747 new patients were admitted nationwide in a single 24-hour period. August saw the worst dengue outbreak this year, reporting over 20,000 infections. Experts predict the situation could worsen further in October, requiring more action. Destroying mosquito breeding grounds remains the long-term effective solution.

stories.summary: A significant paleontological breakthrough has occurred in Spain, where researchers have identified the first confirmed Diplodocus fossils beyond North America. Found in Teruel, these tail vertebrae date back around 150 million years. The discovery implies that during the Late Jurassic era, declining sea levels could have permitted dinosaurs to migrate between continents.

stories.title: Leonardo DiCaprio's foundation donated $1 million to save African elephants being killed for ivory tusks
stories.summary: The dramatic decline in elephant numbers is largely attributable to illegal hunting and the persistent ivory trade. Efforts such as the Elephant Crisis Fund are pivotal in stopping this trend. Leonardo DiCaprio's foundation has notably contributed to these conservation endeavors. Several countries have instated international prohibitions on ivory trade, and while conservation organizations observe a decrease in poaching, they also note the challenges in data accuracy.

With camera traps recording a plethora of species, such as bears and wolves, this area now joins a broader network of safeguarded open land, ensuring its untouched beauty remains for future generations.

stories.summary: Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf lawmakers protested soaring fuel prices by riding donkey carts. Petrol prices reached 390.79 rupees per litre and diesel 424.92 rupees. Austerity measures, including market closures and reduced fuel allocations, were also reinstated.

stories.summary: President Donald Trump will meet acting Venezuelan President Delcy Rodriguez in New York. This meeting occurs during a reception for leaders attending the UN General Assembly. This poignant spectacle lasted for several hours and marks the inaugural scientific documentation of such a phenomenon among humpback whales, shedding light on the profound maternal connections and possible expressions of grief within these majestic creatures.

OC San says the space is needed to maintain an ageing wastewater pipeline, while a court has allowed the homeowners’ case to proceed to trial.

Visitors can look forward to exploring this enlarged haven after several years of dedicated development.

stories.summary: Brazilian TikToker Evelyn Lima Dantas, 21, was reportedly shot and killed in Mãe do Rio, Brazil, on Sept. 16. Police said two men allegedly entered her home, dragged her outside and shot her multiple times. Dantas had more than 150,000 followers across social media. She had been arrested in July during an investigation into a police sergeant’s killing and was provisionally released on Sept. 9. Authorities are investigating a possible connection.
